primary_estimand: Effect of a 20-week exercise program vs no-exercise control on whole-blood gene expression in girls with overweight/obesity: group (exercise vs control) x time (pre vs post) interaction, analysed in girls separately (S2.6.2.p1)
planned_contrasts: girls: exercise vs control change from pre to post (group x time interaction); paper: 121 genes at unadjusted P<0.05, 0 at FDR<0.05 (S3.2.p1)
paper_method: Quantile normalization, then limma group x time interaction, boys and girls separately (S2.6.2.p1); GEO files are named voomQuantiles, so likely voom with quantile normalization; the OSF scripts were not available
sample_inclusion: 24 children with transcriptome data at both time points: boys 5 EX / 8 CON, girls 5 EX / 6 CON (S2.1.p1, TAB1)

paper_results.boys: 161 DEGs (71 up, 90 down), P<0.05; none FDR<0.05
paper_results.girls: 121 DEGs (51 up, 70 down), P<0.05; none FDR<0.05
